title: Foodies
blurb: Hot sauce heroes, fussy eaters, brunch snobs and who steals your chips.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to order something just because they couldn't pronounce it?
Who is most likely to steal a chip off your plate and lie about it?
Who would be most likely to argue about the right way to make a carbonara?
Who would put pineapple on everything?
Who has the worst taste in pizza toppings?
Who among us is most likely to own a drawer full of sauces they never open?
Who would be most likely to enter a hot wing challenge and regret every bite?
Who do you reckon is most likely to cry while chopping onions in front of everyone?
Who's the one most likely to burn toast in a toaster with a "perfect" setting?
Who would be most likely to bring a cheeseboard to a barbecue unasked?
Who is most likely to order dessert first?
Who would be most likely to take a picture of their food, then eat it cold?
Who would eat a whole block of cheese in one go?
Who among us is most likely to say they're "not that hungry" and finish everyone's leftovers?
Who would be most likely to start a bakery after one good loaf of bread?
Who do you reckon is most likely to try a sushi train and stack the plates higher than their head?
Who's the one most likely to wait in a queue for an hour for a doughnut?
Who would be most likely to ask the waiter "what's good here?" and order something else?
Who is most likely to get food on their shirt before the entrée arrives?
Who would be most likely to tell you the exact month that mangoes are best?
Who would complain that the portion was too small and then not finish it?
Who would last longest on a diet of only one food forever?
Who among us is most likely to put hot sauce on a dessert?
Who would be most likely to try the weirdest ice cream flavour on the menu?
Who do you reckon is most likely to take a cooking class and then never cook again?
Who's the one most likely to go to a fancy restaurant and ask for tomato sauce?
Who would be most likely to fall asleep after a big lunch and wake up hungry again?
Who is most likely to ruin a casserole with "a few extra ingredients"?
Who would be most likely to host a dinner party where nothing is ready on time?
Who would survive a cooking show on charm alone?
Who among us is most likely to eat the garnish and then the plate?
Who would be most likely to be banned from a buffet?
Who do you reckon is most likely to bring a mystery dish to a potluck with no label?
Who's the one most likely to get a coffee order that takes ten minutes to say?
Who would be most likely to eat breakfast food at dinner every night?
Who is most likely to put Vegemite on something that isn't toast and defend it?
Who would be most likely to eat a mystery meat pie at a footy ground and ask for a second?
Who would sneak their own snacks into a fancy restaurant?
Who among us is most likely to start a food blog and post one review?
Who would be most likely to survive a day foraging in the bush?
Who has the best secret recipe that they refuse to share?
Who do you reckon is most likely to take leftovers home and forget them for a week?
Who's the one most likely to put sprinkles on something savoury?
Who would be most likely to plan an entire holiday around where to eat?
Who is most likely to win a competitive eating contest by sheer enthusiasm?
